coco_source: Official COCO 2017 person_keypoints_train2017 + train2017 images (images.cocodataset.org); Terms 3 permit COCO pre-training.

factor_synthesis.scope: Extra factors after unchanged parent crop/flip/photometry/personpaste0.35. Fixed strength law and RNG stream. No PETA residual calibration.

init_note: Continuation of L3 (35 x 48k: COCO-only MAE -> COCO 2017 + PoseTrack18 keypoint pre-training) by 20 x 48k with the same recipe (warm-up 1, LR drop at 17): L4 = 55 x 48k.
posetrack18_source: Official mmpose-converted PoseTrack18 annotations (download.openmmlab.com) + official image tar parts aa/ab (owner andriluk/schiele) from the Hyper.AI figshare mirror; the mirror is truncated, so only persons whose image exists are used.
purpose: L4 keypoint pre-training: 971939 showed +0.0020 Public for L3 over L2 (3x its fused dev gain). Same data (COCO 2017 + PoseTrack18 only, Terms 3), recipe and schedule as L3; new seeds for a fresh data order.
revision_note: r1 of vit_pre_COCOPT_L4 (identical recipe). The first launch 20261010T114036442936 died at model.cuda() with CUDA OOM before any step because a concurrent launcher on the shared GPU took the free memory during setup; r1 claims 6.5 GiB at process start (audit peak reserved 5.67 GiB).
